title: Windows owner trace should locate scratch bootstrap evidence before archival
outcome: A retained run trace names the existing compilerScratch and bootstrapPath before PowerShell starts, so in-progress or guardian-death diagnostics can locate the shell/native breadcrumb file without scanning scratch directories.
acceptance: The guardian's own pre-PowerShell trace entry includes the exact owned compilerScratch and bootstrapPath; it does not expose the private command environment or create a second evidence owner.
A focused existing owner/launcher regression verifies the trace points to the actual per-owner scratch bootstrap while successful archival and strict cleanup behavior remain intact.
